resources.string: Backups are unencrypted and may contain private history and notes. Share only with people you trust.
Current data will be replaced, without merging gardens. A local safety copy is saved first. A dead tree may return to an earlier state if the backup predates its death.
Unable to process file. Existing data is preserved; check the file, free space and access permission.
Clear this garden and start again? You can export a backup first.

No account required. Primary gameplay data stays on this device; you choose where backup files are saved. Notifications are optional. The local safety copy may contain history and is removed on uninstall.
Days reset in local time; trees retain their planting timezone. Tree progress uses percentages. No sound is currently played; reduced motion is available in Settings.
Text size follows system settings. Controls retain at least 48 dp touch targets; states include text and icons.
Exports version, Android API, size and row counts only; excludes task names, notes, balance and private tree state.
Recovering the safety copy replaces current data. Export current data first to keep both.
